Then after we can continue the altcoin speculation & outperformance again (still selectively of course).

tweets.text:
Reading about someone being tied up and held at knifepoint for $800k in crypto is fucking horrifying.

We spend hours discussing wallet security and barely talk about how easily an account can be connected to a person, a home, a family.

A PnL screenshot shows the money. 
A few lifestyle posts reveal the location. 
Someone willing to hurt you can connect the two.

With TOKEN2049 just wrapping up, it’s also worth thinking about what we share around events. Meeting people and putting a face to an account is great. Nobody should feel wrong for doing that.

But your face, your holdings, your hotel and your whereabouts don’t all need to be public together.

Post photos after leaving. 
Keep balances and accommodation private. 
Ask before tagging someone who stays anonymous.

None of this puts the blame on the victim. The people doing this are fucking criminals.

But privacy deserves the same attention as custody. Your security setup has to account for someone showing up at your door.

tweets.text:
Bought some long term $SECZ exposure.

Been researching into ways to express bullishness into the tokenization sector. Fact is, there is no easy or straight forward play.

$SECZ is extremely high beta, metrics are still mediocre in terms of revenue (making a loss too), this is essentially a call option on future growth of both tokenization and Securitize itself.

Other tokenization options could include $COIN, $HOOD, $CRCL and obviously your favorite RWA/DeFi like coins. Everyone is trying to gain a small piece of the pie eventually. 

Players like Coinbase got the users and will collect a big part of it. Also with their USDC fee collection. But you're also exposed to the rest of the business, the stablecoin part is very rate sensitive and the tokenization part is really just a fraction of the exposure you're buying into at that point. As is the way for most of these plays.

Coming back to Securitize,

The 17th of September news:
The SEC opened a 5 year path for tokenized US stocks to trade onchain.

The key detail: only tokens with the same rights as the real share qualify. Dividends, voting, all of it.

That rules out most wrapper products. The other is exactly the model Securitize has been building. That gives them an edge there. Of course the market did react and price moved from ~$7 to ~$17. From which it has given back more than half of those gains by now trading back to ~$11 at the time of writing this.

The other side:
Revenue fell 5% last quarter and guidance got cut. 
Still loss making.
Supply overhang in the form of Sponsor earnout shares. This will cap rallies until that is burned through. I expect this process to take a while, even if things turn bullish.

Q3 earnings in November won't show any the SEC impact yet. So anyone betting on better guidance or metrics on November 20th will likely be disappointed.

Honestly this stock is a lot like many crypto projects. The narrative and idea is solid. But the "tokenomics" aren't the best for now. That is a obvious risk and with how volatile this moves I am mentally prepared for large daily moves and a potential further drawdown first.

So I sized it for what it is. A long dated call option. With the possibility to add in future months, possibly after the Q3 earnings.

I don't expect any metrics to magically go crazy in the next 3-6 months. This is a long term play.

I just have a high personal conviction that tokenization is going to be a big thing in the next 5+ years. 

With that in mind, it would be a waste not to express that idea in some additional way besides just my precious magic internet coins.
